title: The Announcement That Came Too Early: Berlin Wall, 1989
description:
On 9 November 1989 an East German spokesman, handed a note and not fully briefed, said new travel rules took effect immediately. That night the checkpoints opened. Facts from Wikipedia's account of the fall of the Berlin Wall; photos from Wikimedia Commons with credits in the video.

#Shorts #History #BerlinWall #ColdWar #HiddenPast
